principle: storage follows data nature; each layer has ONE engine, ONE retention regime, ONE integrity story

layers.name: Evidence / Proof plane
layers.engine: surrealdb SCHEMAFULL (PoH exists) OR append-only signed journal per node — open question
layers.integrity: sha256 content-addressed + Ed25519 kernel-signed; PoH anchor on every seal

layers.name: Operational state plane
layers.retention: TTL-driven; completed dispatch archived to L0 after N days

layers.name: Behavioral telemetry plane
layers.retention: hot 90d -> warm zstd archive -> raw optional after distillation sign-off
layers.integrity: corpus manifest sha256 per file; line digests feed L0 models
layers.windows_archive_status: NOT exhausted: unmined veins = tool n-gram workflows, user-correction signals, failure-to-resolution sequences, session trajectories

layers.name: Artifact CAS plane
layers.engine: content-addressed store: flat dirs + sha256 manifest (no S3 by default)
layers.retention: LRU evictable once manifest records source + digest
layers.notes: vault/models, build-targets, db_scratch belong here conceptually; db_scratch misfiled today under 'vault'

layers.name: Coordination ephemeral plane
layers.integrity: atomic rename writes only; never authoritative

engines_considered_and_positioned.sqlite: L2 live telemetry (Hermes) + small single-writer op state (agent-sessions) — embedded, zero ops, FTS built-in
engines_considered_and_positioned.surrealdb: L0 evidence tables + L1 operational OLTP — graph/record links, transactions, existing adapters
engines_considered_and_positioned.files_jsonl: L2 raw streams — append-only, streamable by miners, compressible cold tiers
engines_considered_and_positioned.cas_manifest: L3 artifacts — content addressing is the integrity story for blobs

candidates_rejected_for_now.postgres: ops overhead without a fleet-scale need yet; SurrealDB covers the transactional niche
candidates_rejected_for_now.duckdb: excellent analytics candidate when L2 mining becomes heavy — defer until query patterns justify a second analytic engine
candidates_rejected_for_now.lance/parquet_lake: premature pre-fleet; revisit if telemetry exceeds tens of GB hot
